Odds are generated from each team's actual championship rate across every completed Catdome Cup season — not Vegas math, just history repeating itself. Or not. Futures close Week 1.
Same math, wider net — each team's actual top-3 finish rate across every completed season.

Stake Catpoints against a friend — not the book. Build a challenge below, add it to your slip, then hit Send Challenge from My Bets to text it over. Nothing's live (and no Catpoints move) until they accept.
Pick a player off your roster to outscore a player off theirs. Fantasy points only, that week only.
Stack 2–4 players you think all find the end zone this week, then challenge a friend who thinks at least one whiffs. All legs hit, you win the stake — anyone misses, they do.
Skip your actual matchup — challenge any manager in the league to a side bet on total team score this week, opponent be damned.
RB1 vs. RB1, WR2 vs. WR2 — pick a roster slot and let two guys at the same position settle it.
Higher score wins the week. Lose, and you can run it back next week at double — double or nothing, until someone folds.
Stake Catpoints that your team strands FEWER points on the bench than theirs this week.
H2H challenges a friend sent you. Accept to lock in the stake on both sides, decline to pass — nothing moves until you answer. These always show first.
Every bet you've staked, against the book or a friend, open or settled. Balances update automatically once a week's final.
